title: Common or generic name of the commodity
plain_action: The pack must say what the commodity is -- "biscuits", "mustard oil" -- not only its brand name. Look for that wording.

citation.text: Every package shall bear the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

messages.pass: A commodity-name declaration was located; this presence screen does not establish every category or combination-package requirement.
messages.violation: No common or generic name is declared, or the brand name has been used in its place. Rule 6(1)(b) requires a description of what the commodity actually is.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
